title: Eigenfunctions, free boundaries, and time-frequency localization
summary: We develop an inverse theory for time--frequency localization operators, formulated as a free-boundary problem in which the localization domain is unknown and its boundary is recovered from prescribed spectral data. The guiding principle is that an eigenfunction can itself be regarded as geometric data determining a localization domain, with strong consequences for the associated variational problem.
